traits.name: Afraid
traits.text: Make an Extended Psychology Test against the target’s Fear. Until accumulated SL equal or exceed its rating, gain no Momentum; its melee attacks against you have Advantage (p. 183).

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Has Swim; +1 SL to Swim Tests. Full Movement in water.

traits.name: Animosity
traits.text: On encountering the listed target, make a Psychology Test. Failure: attack socially or physically as appropriate; +1 SL to Fellowship-based Tests to oppose or disparage them (p. 183).

traits.name: Belligerent
traits.text: Immune to Fear while possessing Momentum.

traits.name: Bestial
traits.text: No rational thought/language; defends only with Dodge. Shies from fire; fire Wounds inflict Broken. Flees after losing over half Wounds; enters Frenzy instead if cornered, protecting young or Territorial.

traits.name: Bite
traits.text: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at Rating Damage (SB already included); uses WS/BS without spending the turn’s Action.

traits.name: Blessed
traits.text: Can enact the listed deity’s Blessings; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

traits.name: Bounce
traits.text: When Charging, Leaping or Sprinting, double Movement and leap over intervening terrain and creatures.

traits.name: Breath
traits.text: Magical ranged Free Attack: choose a visible creature within 20 + TB yards; it and every creature within SB yards of it oppose a single Ballistic Skill roll with their own Dodge Tests. Use BS 30 if the attacker has no BS. Losing targets suffer Rating Damage. Apply any listed Breath type: Acid — TB +4 Damage, and all weapons and armour carried by targets take 1 Damage. Cold — SB +2 Damage and a Fatigued Condition; affected weapons have Slow until that Condition ends. Electricity — SB +2 Damage, ignoring metal armour, and a Stunned Condition. Fire — SB +3 Damage and an Ablaze Condition. Poison — TB +2 Damage and a Poisoned Condition. Smoke — fills the area, blocks line of sight and causes Suffocation (p. 169) for TB Rounds. The attacker is immune to its own Breath.

traits.name: Champion
traits.text: Winning an Opposed Test while defending in melee deals Damage as if attacking.

traits.name: Chill Grasp
traits.text: Lose Momentum and use an Action: Opposed WS against Dodge or Melee. Win: target loses 1d10 + SL Wounds, ignoring TB and AP. Magical.

traits.name: Cold-blooded
traits.text: Advantage on Cool Tests. Surprised is not removed the first time it normally would be.

traits.name: Constrictor
traits.text: Every successful hit inflicts Entangled; may then initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

traits.name: Construct
traits.text: No Int, WP or Fel; never Tests them, except use T for required WP Tests. Use SB instead of WPB for Wounds. All attacks Magical. Without a controlling spellcaster, or without Territorial, wanders mindlessly.

traits.name: Corrosive Blood
traits.text: Whenever wounded, all Engaged targets take 1d10 Damage (one roll for all).

traits.name: Corruption
traits.text: A Corrupting Influence of the listed strength (p. 187).

traits.name: Dark Vision
traits.text: Sees in darkness as in daylight.

traits.name: Daemonic
traits.text: No food, water or air; all attacks Magical. Non-Magical blow: 1d10, Rating+ ignores it and any Critical. Cannot ignore Magical blows this way. At 0 Wounds, returns to Chaos and leaves play.

traits.name: Disease
traits.text: Carries the listed disease; others Test for Contraction as appropriate (p. 179). Whether the carrier suffers its effects is the GM’s choice.

traits.name: Distracting
traits.text: Living targets within TB yards suffer −2 SL to all Tests. Does not stack with other Distracting creatures.

traits.name: Ethereal
traits.text: Passes through solid objects. Only Magical attacks can harm it; all its attacks are Magical.

traits.name: Fear
traits.text: Extended Psychology Test. Until accumulated SL exceed Rating (default 1): no Momentum; attackers gain Advantage in melee (p. 183).

traits.name: Fly
traits.text: As its Move, fly up to Rating yards, ignoring intervening terrain, obstacles and creatures; may Charge. End landed or airborne; if starting a turn airborne, must Fly or fall (GM decides distance). Against it, measure horizontal range then increase one range step (Extreme becomes unreachable). While flying, −20 to its Ranged Attacks.

traits.name: Frenzy
traits.text: WP Test to enter: Free Attack each Round, +1 Damage, immune to Psychology. Only attack or move to attack nearest visible enemy; no fleeing/retreat. Ends with no visible enemies or if Stunned or Unconscious; then Fatigued.

traits.name: Ghostly Howl
traits.text: Once per turn, lose Momentum for a Magical Free Attack. Living hearers within Strength yards gain 3 Deafened and lose 1d10 Wounds ignoring TB/AP; Average (+2 SL) Cool or also Broken.

traits.name: Grim
traits.text: At the end of its turn, gains Momentum if it has none.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: On meeting target: Psychology Test; failure activates Hatred. Attack by fastest, deadliest means; +1 SL Melee/Ranged against them. Immune to their Intimidate/Fear, not Terror (p. 184).

traits.name: Horns
traits.text: When Charging into combat, may make a Free Attack at SB +4 Damage.

traits.name: Hungry
traits.text: After killing/incapacitating living prey or finding a fresh corpse: Average (+2 SL) Cool or feast; lose next Move and Action.

traits.name: Immune to Psychology
traits.text: Ignores Psychology rules (p. 183).

traits.name: Immunity
traits.text: Ignores all harm of the listed type, including Critical Wounds.

traits.name: Infected
traits.text: On causing a living opponent to lose Wounds: Easy (+4 SL) Endurance or contract a Festering Wound (p. 180).

traits.name: Infestation
traits.text: Opponents suffer −1 SL to hit it in melee.

traits.name: Many Heads
traits.text: Head Criticals stun, kill or render unconscious only when all heads are disabled or similarly affected. With Bite, Horns or Tongue, make as many Free Attacks as healthy heads. With 2+ healthy heads, +2 SL to Perception.

traits.name: Mark of Chaos
traits.text: Khorne: Frenzy; Etiquette (Followers of Khorne). Animosity towards overt Slaanesh followers (reciprocal while Mark visible). Language (Magick)/Channelling: dispelling only. Career Talents at normal XP: Berserk Charge, Combat Aware, Combat Reflexes, Furious Assault, Implacable, Magic Resistance, Resistance (Magic), Resolute, Strike Mighty Blow, Warrior Born. Nurgle: +10 Toughness; Etiquette (Followers of Nurgle). Animosity towards overt Tzeentch followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Frightening, Hardy, Implacable, Iron Jaw, Menacing, Resistance (Poison), Resistance (Disease), Robust, Tenacious, Very Resilient. Slaanesh: Fearless (Everything); Etiquette (Followers of Slaanesh). Animosity towards overt Khorne followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Attractive, Blather, Careful Strike, Combat Master, Gregarious, Inspiring, Lightning Reflexes, Nimblefingered, Resistant (Poison), Sharp. Tzeentch: Roll 1d10/3 Mutations, rounding up, alternating Mental and Physical. Etiquette (Followers of Tzeentch). Animosity towards overt Nurgle followers; they reciprocate while the Mark is visible. Career purchases at normal XP: Aethyric Attunement, Arcane Magic (Any), Chaos Magic (Tzeentch), Fast Hands, Instinctive Diction, Magical Sense, Petty Magic, Second Sight, War Wizard, Witch!.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: All attacks are Magical and can harm creatures vulnerable only to Magical attacks.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Casting Tests for spells affecting it suffer −3 SL. Incompatible with Channelling or Arcane Magic, Bless, Chaos Magic, Invoke, Petty Magic and Witch! Talents (in either direction).

traits.name: Mental Corruption
traits.text: Roll on the Mental Corruption table (p. 189).

traits.name: Miracles
traits.text: Can enact the listed deity’s Miracles; Pray at Fellowship +10 (GM may increase).

traits.name: Mutation
traits.text: Roll on the Physical Corruption table (p. 189).

traits.name: Night Vision
traits.text: See clearly in natural darkness for 20 yards; extend the illumination distance of light sources by 20 yards.

traits.name: Painless
traits.text: Ignores non-amputation Critical Wound penalties; Conditions still apply.

traits.name: Petrifying Gaze
traits.text: Lose Momentum and an Action against one visible living target: Opposed BS/Initiative (spellcasters may defend with Language (Magick)). Win: 1 Stunned, +1 per SL after the first. Win by 6+ SL: permanently turn target to stone.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text: Round start: above 0 Wounds, heal 1d10; at 0, heal 1 on 1d10 of 8+. A roll of 10 fully heals one Critical and its penalties/Conditions. Cannot regenerate fire-caused Wounds/Criticals.

traits.name: Size
traits.text: Size determines Wounds, primary melee Damage and combat interactions. Small: Wounds 2 × TB; no added Damage; counts as 1 when outnumbered. Average: Wounds SB + 2 × TB + WPB; no added Damage; counts as 1. Large: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×2; add SB Damage; counts as 2. Enormous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×4; add SB Damage; counts as 3. Monstrous: Wounds (SB + 2 × TB + WPB) ×8; add 2 × SB Damage; counts as 4. These Damage bonuses are already included in NPC profiles and do not apply to ranged or extra attacks. Tiny has no supplied Wounds formula, Damage modifier or outnumbering count; retain its baseline or set Wounds manually. Melee defence against a larger creature suffers −2 SL. Aggressive creatures cause Fear in smaller creatures. Creatures may leave melee with smaller opponents without Disengaging. In Opposed Strength or similar Tests, a creature at least 2 Size steps larger wins automatically; with a 1-step difference, the smaller creature must roll a Critical to compare SL normally, otherwise it loses. The outnumbering counts above apply only when determining whether the larger creature is outnumbered; it counts as 1 for its own outnumbering bonus. Against a smaller opponent, lose Momentum for one Stomp as a Free Attack using Melee (Brawling), with SB Damage. Each upward Size adjustment gives +10 Strength, +10 Toughness and −5 Agility; reverse these changes when shrinking. Ignore Size rules while Swarm applies (p. 362).

traits.name: Skittish
traits.text: Spectacular visible magic, thunderclaps or explosions inflict 3 Broken Conditions.

traits.name: Spellcaster
traits.text: Casts the listed Lore(s). Add Spellcaster/Spellcaster Lord template, or grant Channelling (chosen Wind) at WP +10 and Language (Magick) at Int +10 as Basic Skills (GM may increase).

traits.name: Sprinter
traits.text: Run Movement ×1.5 when Running.

traits.name: Stealthy
traits.text: Stealth (Rural) at Agility +10 (GM may increase).

traits.name: Striding Gait
traits.text: No movement penalties in the listed terrain; +1 SL to Athletics and Stealth there.

traits.name: Stupid
traits.text: If no nearby ally lacks Stupid, make Easy (+4 SL) Intelligence at each Round’s start. Failure: lose that turn’s Move and Action. Nearby non-Stupid allies prevent this.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: Acts as one creature; ignores Psychology, Engaged restrictions on moving and all Size rules. Each Engaged opponent loses 1 Wound at Round end. Has ×5 normal Wounds and +10 WS; shooting at it gains +40 to hit.

traits.name: Tail
traits.text: Lose Momentum for a Free Attack at SB +2 Damage; smaller targets losing any Wounds also become Prone.

traits.name: Tentacles
traits.text: One Free Attack per tentacle at SB +0 Damage. Causing Damage may inflict Entangled and initiate a Grapple with that tentacle. Resolve its Grapple with the tentacle’s Free Attack, not the creature’s Action (p. 167).

traits.name: Territorial
traits.text: Fights to the death defending its area; normally does not pursue enemies beyond it.

traits.name: Terror
traits.text: First encounter: Psychology Test; failure gives Broken equal to Rating +1 per negative SL. Causes Fear of same Rating regardless of result (p. 183).

traits.name: Tongue
traits.text: Lose Momentum for a ranged Free Attack at SB +0 Damage. GM sets range (default 3 yards at Small–Large; 12 for larger). Hit: 1 Entangled; smaller targets dragged into melee. Then release, make a Weapon-Trait Free Attack, or keep wrapped and initiate a Grapple (p. 167).

traits.name: Tracker
traits.text: Track at Intelligence +10 (GM may increase).

traits.name: Trained
traits.text: Animal Training teaches the options listed in parentheses; additional training options may be created. Broken: ignore Bestial and gain +2d10 Fellowship. Drive: pull carts, coaches, ploughs, buggies or similar loads. Entertain: +10 to appropriate Entertain, Perform or Play Tests. Fetch: retrieve objects, normally for dogs and similar animals. Guard: remain at or patrol a guarded place; gain Territorial. Home: return home when released or lost. Magic: ignore Skittish caused by magic, as required for most spellcasters’ mounts. Mount: accept a rider; belligerent animals may require a specific Ride specialisation, such as Ride (Griffon) for a griffon. War: +10 Weapon Skill and ignore Skittish caused by loud noises.

traits.name: Undead
traits.text: Needs no air, food, water or other life necessities; counts as Undead for spells, Miracles and abilities.

traits.name: Unstable
traits.text: Round end: Engaged opponent has Momentum and creature has none → driven back; lose 2 Wounds. Destroyed or banished at 0 Wounds.

traits.name: Vampiric
traits.text: Successful Bite against suitable prey: heal Wounds equal to target’s loss. Blood-drinking is its only healing method.

traits.name: Venom
traits.text: Causing Wounds inflicts Poisoned. The listed Difficulty applies to Tests to recover from Poisoned, not to avoid it (p. 186).

traits.name: Vomit
traits.text: If starting the turn Engaged, spend Move and Action: one BS roll opposed by each target’s Dodge within 2 yards. Attacker Easy (+4 SL), defenders Challenging (+0 SL). Losing targets take TB +4 Damage and Stunned; all their carried weapons/armour take 1 Damage. Once per 12 hours.

traits.name: Ward
traits.text: After any blow, roll 1d10: Rating+ ignores the blow, including Criticals.

traits.name: Wallcrawler
traits.text: Full Movement on suitable vertical surfaces and ceilings; automatically passes Climb Tests.

traits.name: Web
traits.text: Each successful hit inflicts 1 Entangled, with Strength equal to Rating (p. 186).

traits.name: Vigor Mortis
traits.text: Undead within 8 of the Corpse Cart ignore Unstable, except for the Cart itself. Necromancy spells cast within 8 gain +20. Destroying the Cart ends both effects.

traits.name: Balefire Brazier
traits.text: Replace Vigor Mortis’s Necromancy casting bonus with −20 to every Lore (Magic) check within 8. Nearby Undead retain its protection from Unstable.

traits.name: Arboreal
traits.text: In woodlands, increase Stealth and Climb Test SL by the creature’s Agility Bonus.

traits.name: Die Hard
traits.text: Any Critical Wound may heal. During the TB Rounds immediately after death, test Endurance at Challenging (+0 SL) at each Round’s start; success restores life with 1 Wound.
traits.adaptation: User-supplied older-edition definition retained; no direct Fifth Edition equivalent.

traits.name: Prejudice
traits.text: Prejudice (Thin People) is a reference entry: the source supplies no Fifth Edition mechanics or Test modifiers.

traits.name: Corrupting Vomit
traits.text: A hit from Chaos Troll vomit exposes the target to a risk of Corruption (Moderate).

traits.name: Rotten Regeneration
traits.text: Apply core Regeneration, restoring 1d10 ÷ 2 Wounds, rounded down, instead (Tribes and Tribulations, p. 88).

traits.name: Bileful Vomit
traits.text: Vomit uses Stream of Corruption (CN 9; special Range/Target; instant): Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack, a magic missile at TB Damage ignoring AP. Targets losing more than their TB in Wounds: Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or Blood Rot (core pp. 179, 357).

traits.name: That’s No Mound
traits.text: Stealthy applies only while the Troll has neither moved nor taken an Action.

traits.name: Sated
traits.text: The Hungry Troll template ends after the Troll eats an Average-sized or larger creature undisturbed.

traits.name: Starving
traits.text: The Hungry Troll begins suffering Starvation after 24 hours without food.

traits.name: Water Wise
traits.text: A River Troll Hag ignores Stupid while in a body of water; Stupid applies elsewhere.

traits.name: Purple Skullback Bite
traits.text: If wounded and Poisoned by the bite: Average (+2 SL) Cool or gain 1 Corruption. Forest Goblin Shamans still take damage/poison; for 2d10 hours gain printed +2d10 to Channelling/Language (Magick) and may reroll Waaagh! Miscasts. Bonuses are temporary.
traits.adaptation: Printed Average (+20) uses core Average (+2 SL); current Venom inflicts Poisoned on Wounds without an avoidance Test.

traits.name: Lure of the Lurkerfish
traits.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Riverways) identifies the lure. On failure, Easy (+4 SL) Cool or become beguiled: may only move towards the light, effectively Unconscious.
traits.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

traits.name: Slimy
traits.text: When Grappled, pass a Toughness Test for +4 SL to subsequent escape Tests. Opponent makes Challenging (+0 SL) Athletics; failure: release the Latch-eel or suffer Suffocation.

traits.name: Love the Light
traits.text: Attracted to light; fire encourages rather than deters it. Despite Bestial, does not shy from fire or gain Broken from flaming attacks.

traits.name: Immersion
traits.text: Grapple; inflicting Entangled draws the victim inside, causing Suffocation. Escape Entangled as a Grapple with Opposed Strength against 59. The Elemental need not maintain the Grapple, may act freely and does not count as Engaged by the immersed victim.

traits.name: Fire Resistant
traits.text: Sea Elementals are immune to Ablaze Conditions.

traits.name: Mindless Spellcaster
traits.text: A Sea Elemental may cast spells and channel using Strength.

traits.name: Boat Crusher
traits.text: Constrict vessels of Size Large or smaller: spend 1 turn wrapping per 10 vessel Size. Then Extended Opposed Strength/vessel Toughness; accumulated SL equal to vessel Wounds shatters it. Crew may attack or lever it off: a hit causing over 7 Wounds forces Average (+2 SL) Cool or release. Levering uses Opposed Strength: 0–4 SL stops squeezing that turn; 5+ forces release.
traits.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

traits.name: Electrical Discharge
traits.text: After Grappling, spend 1 Momentum at the start of a subsequent turn: 10 Damage ignoring non-magical metal armour; if wounded, Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or Stunned. Each use requires Average (+2 SL) Endurance or gain Fatigued; while Fatigued, shock Damage drops to 6. Against a Grappled boat, damages no hull but hits every crew member for 6 Damage (3 if Fatigued).
traits.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers. Printed Advantage uses Momentum.

traits.name: Whale Bane
traits.text: Fanged Maw attacks use core Venom: inflicting Wounds gives Poisoned, with Difficult (−1 SL) recovery Tests. This Difficulty governs recovery.
traits.adaptation: Uses full Fifth Edition Venom rather than the older on-hit interpretation.

traits.name: Syreen’s Call
traits.text: Action: sing. Characters within Initiative yards: Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or beguiled, effectively Unconscious and able only to move towards the Syreen.
traits.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

traits.name: Resistant to Cold
traits.text: May make an Endurance Test to ignore ill effects of cold/ice weapons, spells or other effects.

traits.name: Lure of the Leviathan
traits.text: Hard (−2 SL) Lore (Oceans) identifies the lure and allows looking away. Failure: Easy (+4 SL) Cool or Stunned.
traits.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulty uses current SL modifiers.

traits.name: Devastating Assault
traits.text: A Black Leviathan charging a ship causes a CR 50 collision.

traits.name: On a Different Scale
traits.text: Bestial, but only fire at least as large/intense as a large bonfire frightens it. GM judges Fear/Terror sources by whether their size merits its respect; smaller ordinary threats do not concern it.

traits.name: Marine Creature
traits.text: Full Movement in water; printed profile assumes aquatic conditions. On land: Movement 1 and −2 SL to all Tests. Must be regularly doused or begin Suffocating.

traits.name: Telepathy
traits.text: Transmit/read thoughts without speech. To resist thought-reading: Average (+2 SL) Cool.
traits.adaptation: Named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Chameleon
traits.text: Perception to spot it: −4 SL (−2 while moving). Ranged Tests to shoot it: −2 SL.

traits.name: Flammable
traits.text: Tests to avoid Ablaze suffer the printed −20 penalty. Ablaze causes twice the normal Wounds.

traits.name: Stationary Attacker
traits.text: Immune to Psychology; cannot pursue, manoeuvre, Charge, Flee, Leap, Run or Climb. May only take attack/Trait actions. Unsuspecting prey entering reach becomes Engaged; its sprung attack inflicts Surprised. Detect with Challenging (+0 SL) Perception, then suitable Lore; either failure leaves the threat unrecognised. Reach: Tiny/Little Very Short; Small Short; Average Medium; Large Long; Enormous Very Long; Monstrous Massive.

traits.name: Auger and Scryer
traits.text: May use the supplied Psychometry/Augury rules; Psychometry counts as Basic. Ignores the prohibition against being both magician and Scryer.

traits.name: Contemplation
traits.text: When unattended and surroundings change, Difficult (−1 SL) Perception. +2 SL or more: alert; 0 to +1: Stupid for the encounter, then alert or meditating as circumstances dictate; −0 to −3: 2 Fatigued, only Move or Action each turn; −4 or less: unresponsive. If unresponsive, stimuli allow a new Challenging (+0 SL) Perception Test; weapons/magic attacks make it Easy (+4 SL). Telepathic warning from a Slann or Skink magic-user makes it alert.
traits.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulties use core Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Knack for Total Power
traits.text: Successful Casting Tests are Criticals on doubles or a units die of 0. In Lustria, may reroll Tests to perceive the Winds of Magic.

traits.name: Master of Magical Mishaps
traits.text: Major Miscasts become Minor, except when casting through another spellcaster via Telepathy.

traits.name: Emergency Teleportation
traits.text: At 10 Wounds or fewer, or a Critical causing broken bones/torn muscles or worse, may immediately cast Teleport as a free action. Success sends the Slann to the nearest temple-city’s star chamber (a neighbouring one if unsafe). Only Slann are known to survive these Geomantic Web amulets.

traits.name: Relic Priest
traits.text: Spirit stays within WPB yards of its body; both have equal Wounds. Destroying the body destroys the spirit; damage to either may trigger Emergency Teleportation. Spirit may possess the body to direct a palanquin; otherwise body cannot move/act and is always Prone. Spirit may cast with Move and Action (up to 2 spells/turn); melee ability is defence only and deals no damage.

traits.name: Slann Telepathy
traits.text: Network: Slann and Skink Priests within Willpower yards; if within Willpower yards of a Geomantic Web flow, also Slann within that distance of another flow. Spend Action or Move and pass Challenging (+0 SL) Intelligence: exchange up to 5 minutes’ conversation in one turn, or cast through a networked Skink Priest using the Slann’s Characteristics/Skills/Talents. Miscasts affect the Skink.
traits.adaptation: Printed Test Difficulties use core Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Palanquin
traits.text: Grants Fly (16) and Ward (8+); hard cover against missiles from rear/sides, soft cover from the front.

traits.name: Chariots of the Asur
traits.text: Swiftfeather Rocs are the only willing Skycutter draught animals. Safe, effective flight requires an Elf’s reflexes.

traits.name: Blood Hungry Spore Cloud
traits.text: Movement by Human-sized or larger warm-blooded creatures within 1 yard triggers a spore cloud: 5-yard radius, 3 yards high, lasting 2d10 Rounds. Warm-blooded creatures caught inside: Difficult (−1 SL) Endurance or 1 Bleeding.
traits.adaptation: Named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Impale Attack
traits.text: Always strikes legs without the usual −20 called-shot penalty. Ignores leather armour; has Impale.

traits.name: Entangled Attack
traits.text: Only attacks warm-blooded prey. Cannot use Weapon until the target is Entangled; then strikes once per turn until it escapes or dies.

traits.name: Magical Snack
traits.text: Eating an Itxi Grub grants a spellcaster +1 SL to Casting and Channelling for 3d10 Rounds. Does not stack.

traits.name: Posterior Flame
traits.text: Rough handling or sudden disturbance by warm-blooded creatures triggers flames for 1d10 Rounds. Any character or flammable item touching it gains Ablaze.

traits.name: Use as Ammunition
traits.text: Handle with Animal Care: Very Easy (+6 SL) for cold-blooded, Hard (−2 SL) for warm-blooded. Damp leather pouch holds up to 6 Fireleeches docile for 24 hours if not badly jostled. A second Animal Care Test readies one to throw or sling; failure inflicts Ablaze on the handler.
traits.adaptation: Named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Brain Rot
traits.text: A head Critical against warm-blooded prey burrows into its skull and inflicts Brain Rot in addition to Damage (p. 186).

traits.name: Excruciating Sting
traits.text: While Poisoned by the sting, test Difficult (−1 SL) Cool at each turn’s start; failure adds Stunned.
traits.adaptation: Named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Odour Attack
traits.text: When harassed, odour spreads 1d10 yards. Cold-blooded targets: Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance or Nausea for 1d10 hours. Warm-blooded creatures suffer no symptom.
traits.adaptation: Named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Scalemane Reptilion Venomous Bite
traits.text: Venom inflicts 2 Poisoned instead of 1.

traits.name: Blue-Ringed Asp Venomous Bite
traits.text: Venom also inflicts Bleeding, lasting until Poisoned is resolved.

traits.name: Boring Attack
traits.text: Attacks have Damaging and Impale.

traits.name: Shooting Spine Attack
traits.text: May fire spines singly or en masse; they regenerate in 1 day.

traits.name: Unstoppable Charge
traits.text: Charging grants a Stegadon +3 Momentum.
traits.adaptation: Old Advantage becomes Momentum; named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Ramming Attack
traits.text: Healthy Pliodons have Collision Rating 14 when ramming vessels.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.text: On causing a combat Wound, immediately becomes Frenzied until all foes within its senses are slain.

traits.name: Toxic Bile
traits.text: Projects bile up to 15 yards; any character hit gains Ablaze.

traits.name: Fearsome Roar
traits.text: Enormous/Monstrous predators: Difficult (−1 SL) Cool or suffer Fear and leave immediately. Prey and smaller creatures: Hard (−2 SL) Cool or flee in Fear.
traits.adaptation: Named Test Difficulties use Fifth Edition SL modifiers.

traits.name: Dooming
traits.text: Innate Blessed (Morr)-like access to the Dooming Miracle. Uses Willpower, not Invoke; owes no allegiance to a Human god.

mutations.name: Extra Mouth
mutations.text: Determine the affected location with one roll on the Hit Locations table.

mutations.name: Glowing Skin
mutations.text: Provides as much light as a candle.

mutations.name: Patchy Feathers
mutations.text: Roll twice on the Hit Locations table to determine the affected locations.

mutations.name: Spiny Protrusions
mutations.text: Determine the affected location with one roll on the Hit Locations table.

mutations.name: Uneven Horns
mutations.text: +1 Armour Point to Head; gain Horns

mutations.name: Whiskered Snout
mutations.text: Gain Acute Sense (Smell); +2 SL to Track Tests

mutations.name: Chaotic Dreams
mutations.text: Suffer Fatigued during each day’s first two hours.

mutations.name: Hateful Impulses
mutations.text: Animosity applies to every other Species.

mutations.name: Lonely Spirit
mutations.text: While alone, suffer −10 to every Test.

mutations.name: Shaky Morale
mutations.text: Failing a Fear Test also inflicts Broken.

mutations.name: Unending Malice
mutations.text: Tests to hurt receive +1 SL; all other Tests suffer −1 SL.

training.name: Shock Cavalry
training.adaptation: The printed Challenging (+0) Dodge Test uses Fifth Edition Challenging (+0 SL), following core Appendix I p. 364.
training.text: Requires Trained (War). A Charging rider may pass through smaller creatures to reach the target. Each makes Challenging (+0 SL) Dodge or takes 4 + the mount’s SB Damage; every creature damaged removes 2 yards of remaining Movement. A creature at least the mount’s Size stops the Charge. At the Charge’s end, enemies in melee range are Engaged; resolve the Charge as if one of them were its target. A smaller creature that has not acted this Round may replace its Dodge attempt with one attack using a held weapon against the mount or rider. The Charge continues unless that attack kills or disables the mount.
